w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
firstContext: 📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
You read its weight, its breath, the set of its shoulders. It's winding up Rerun — lands next beat. (Read Stance — pattern known.)
You focus — that costs your action.

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🗣️ Wenjing to Omar, by the fire: "Stone. We need 47 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "TONIGHT: The Talent Pit. Talent show, judged by beings who have never seen talent. Applause is measured in decibels and confusion."
📺 SYSTEM: "The cameras want YOU — won a contest."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (12/10/7), with 4 wave-4 fought, 8 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 8 · Craft 11 · Talk 8 · Explore 22) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Omar Farouk ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store keeps slipping from its recent high — evening after evening, lower.
⚠ The store has fallen further still from its recent high.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,157 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
